visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black beanie and black hoodie sits in the driver's seat of a modern vehicle. He faces the passenger side while talking, gesturing with his right hand. Outside the car window, an urban road with buildings and a gray sky is visible in motion. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor perspective showing a small, brightly colored roadside food stall with red and green awnings. Several motorcycles are parked in front of the stall which is located next to a body of water with residential buildings in the distance under an overcast sky. (3) The man is now seated at a table inside the food stall, holding a wooden skewer with a piece of fried food. He smiles and talks to the camera. On the table, there are multiple plastic bags filled with food and a bottle of red beverage. (4) A close-up shows a kitchen area where a cook wearing blue rubber gloves and a striped shirt is preparing fried food. The cook mixes a bowl of green chopped vegetables and dips items into a thick white batter before placing them into a deep fryer filled with bubbling oil. (5) The man continues to eat and talk at the stall, holding a half-eaten fried oyster fritter in its plastic wrapping. He looks around and gestures towards the surrounding environment while expressing satisfaction. (6) The camera focuses on a red and white sign that reads '第一家蚵嗲' with a thumbs-up graphic. The video ends with a wide shot of the stall again, showing the roadside context and the overcast weather.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking casually inside a car. A soft, rhythmic acoustic guitar plucking serves as background music. A low-frequency hum from the car's engine is audible in the ambient layer. (2) A bright 'Ding' SFX triggers as text appears on screen. The speaker's voice maintains a steady pace and friendly tone. (3) A sharp cut occurs, and the ambient noise shifts to an outdoor environment. The sound of hot oil sizzling is prominently heard as the scene changes to a food stall. (4) A 'Pop' SFX transitions the audio as the man starts eating. Background chatter and distant traffic noise are present. (5) The speaker laughs while describing the food. The music continues to provide a warm, major-mode atmosphere. (6) A final 'Ding' SFX accompanies the closing slogan, and the acoustic BGM swells slightly before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle food vlog recommending a traditional Taiwanese snack, oyster fritters (蚵嗲). The creator contrasts the joy of eating fresh, affordable local street food in a relaxed, open-air setting against the high cost and sterility of food delivery services, promoting a philosophy of 'simple happiness' through local exploration.
